en-US.title: DestinationPacker
en-US.subtitle: Smart travel packing lists
en-US.description:
DestinationPacker helps travelers plan trips, create destination-aware packing lists, check weather context, and organize activity ideas before departure.

Build a trip in minutes: add your destination and dates, pick your travel style and who is coming, and get a packing list tailored to your trip's weather, activities, and travelers. Check items off as you pack, adjust quantities, add your own items, and share the finished list with travel partners.

FEATURES
- Destination-aware packing lists generated for your exact trip
- Weather forecasts with packing adjustments for rain, heat, and cold
- Per-traveler quantities for families and groups, including kids and pets
- Local activity ideas with packing items linked to what you plan to do
- Trip readiness dashboard showing packing progress at a glance
- Shareable checklists for group trips
- Destination briefings with foods to try, customs, and practical notes
